pandas.DataFrame.sparse.to_coo

pandas 3.1.1 · DataFrame · method

Convert sparse pandas data to SciPy coordinate format.

  • Call syntax
  • Inspect the call
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

DataFrame.sparse.to_coo()

Inspect the call

Run this code to inspect the callable and its parameters. Its data, backend, or environment is needed to execute the operation itself.


    

    
Parameters
This call takes no arguments.

    
Returns
scipy.sparse.spmatrix

    
Example for a local Python session
import pandas as pd
import scipy.sparse
frame = pd.DataFrame({"units": [2., 5., 7.], "price": [4., 3., 2.]})
frame = frame.astype(pd.SparseDtype("float64", 0))
print(frame.sparse.to_coo())
